content:
incident-bot: ALERT: High queue depth detected for hosted inference. Region=gcp-west2. Autoscaler attempted scale-up but several allocation requests returned RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED. Throttling observed, latency spikes > 3s. Possible quota/limit hit. Tagging SEV2 and paging on-call.
ashwin (on-call): Got the page, taking it. Looking at /autoscaler and /serving logs now.
maria_sre: Oncall - if it's quota we should fallback traffic fast. Can you confirm which zone(s) failed?
ashwin (on-call): Checking. All scale attempts to gke-cluster-west2-a and -b show "quotaExceeded: Requested gpuCount > availableQuota" in the allocation logs. Autoscaler retried 4x then aborted. Queue growth across routes: /v1/generate and /v1/chat.
lia-cs: I'm seeing spikes in customer errors in the dashboard — a small subset of high-throughput customers (org-23, org-88) have 429s and timeouts. Paging account owners.
maria_sre: Ok - mitigation plan: 1) divert new requests to gcp-us-central1 and us-west1 where capacity is healthy, 2) enable model-fallback to smaller quantized variants for non-enterprise tiers, 3) throttle background batch jobs. Ashwin, can you trigger routing change?
ashwin (on-call): Doing (1) now. Updating routing policy to prefer us-central1 for new sessions. Patch incoming to routing-service.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: routing-service/shift-preference v2.18 -> applied to canary (10% traffic).

ashwin (on-call): Canary applied. Observing traffic shift. Queue growth rate dropping at origin region but still lots of inflight requests.
tina_sre: I'm coming onto this incident (handoff in 10m). Any blockers?
maria_sre: Pending confirmation of GCP quota increase request. We need GCP support ticket opened and quota bump requested for GPUs in west2 (n1-standard + t4/p100 pool). Also consider transiently enabling multi-region bursting.

ashwin (on-call): I opened ticket: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/123456789 — ref: rrw-incident-1769961234. GCP auto-response: "quota limit reached, review or request increase". ETA unknown.
lia-cs: Notifying affected customers with temporary mitigation note: traffic possibly routed to a different region; no data residency change for enterprise customers — flagging legal if needed.
maria_sre: While we wait for GCP, enable two additional mitigations: A) reduce default batch size for generation from 8->4 for hosted API to reduce per-request GPU request footprint; B) enable emergency quantized model variant for standard-tier (model alias: rwd-infer-small-q8). Can dev-platform do (B)?
dev-platform: We can flip a feature-flag for fallback model within 5m. We'll coordinate with on-call to avoid regressions.

ashwin (on-call): Reducing batch size now. Command: 
``` 
curl -X POST https://internal-api/redwood/configs -d '{"batch.default":4}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer x'
```
Applied. Metrics show average token latency dropped slightly but throughput reduced.
maria_sre: dev-platform, flip fallback when ready. Also we should add a rate-limiter on high-throughput orgs to keep service for everyone. Lia, can CS prepare messaging for org-23/org-88?
lia-cs: On it. Short message drafted: "We're routing some of your requests to an alternate region temporarily to maintain availability; you may see slight latency variance. We're working on quota increase with GCP." Sending now.

deploy-bot: feature-flag toggle: rwd-fallback-quantized -> ENABLED for non-enterprise.

dev-platform: Fallback enabled. Observing model mix: 35% of requests now hit quantized variant. Error rate for those customers dropping.

ashwin (on-call): Good. Queue draining observed. However, we still have throttling at gcp-west2 for reserved dedicated pools (dedicated customers pinned to west2). Those customers see degraded service. Need to escalate with Sales/CS for SLA.
maria_sre: Lia, loop in enterprise success and sales for dedicated customers. Provide timeline and mitigation.
lia-cs: Looping in sales now. DM sent to @sales-lead and @acct-team.

tina_sre: Handoff time. I'm the primary now. Summary: quotaExceeded in gcp-west2 caused autoscaler to fail, we've shifted traffic to other regions, reduced batch sizes, and enabled quantized fallback. GCP ticket created (ref above). Current status: partial mitigation, queue draining but dedicated customers still impacted. Next actions: engage GCP support for quota bump, evaluate temporary capacity from cloud partner (ex: request spare GPUs in us-west), prepare a customer-facing incident update.

ashwin (on-call): Adding that we saw autoscaler logs showing 502 from allocation API then 403/RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED. Will attach logs to the GCP ticket.
maria_sre: Tina — please own escalation with GCP. If support ETA > 2h we should consider cross-region migration for dedicated pools or spinning up on-prem reserve (if contractual).
tina_sre: Acknowledged. Opening escalation request and paging partner ops.

lia-cs: Sending public incident update to status.redwood.ai: "Reduced capacity in gcp-west2 causing elevated latency and errors for a subset of customers. Traffic rerouted to alternate regions; mitigations in place. Engineers are working with GCP to restore capacity."
maria_sre: Good. Also capture all mitigations as runbook items for postmortem.

(30m later)
GCP Support (system): Update to case 123456789: "We've increased quota in region gcp-west2 by 40 GPUs in your project. Allocation should succeed. Please retry."

ashwin (on-call): Retrying scale now. Allocation requests succeeding. Autoscaler resumed and new nodes coming up.
maria_sre: Observing capacity recovery, queue draining to baseline. Monitoring errors — dropping.

lia-cs: Customers notified: org-23/org-88 confirm service restored. Dedicated customers still being validated by account teams.

dev-platform: Rolling back fallback flag for non-enterprise in 10m to validate quality.

maria_sre: Nice work. Action items: 1) postmortem (owner: maria_sre), 2) add proactive alerting for GPU quota headroom per-region (owner: dev-platform), 3) document cross-region dedicated pool migration runbook (owner: eng-platform). Tina, Ashwin please include detailed timelines in the postmortem.
tina_sre: On it. I'll start the incident timeline.
ashwin (on-call): Back to normal, handing off to standby for overnight.
maria_sre: Incident declared resolved. Closing the SEV2. Postmortem scheduled for tomorrow 11:00.
lia-cs: Closing customer comms loop.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: 1769961234. Duration: ~1h. Tags: quota, gcp, autoscaling, mitigation, routing, customer-impact.

maria_sre: Postmortem notes: primary cause - insufficient GPU quota in gcp-west2. Contributing: autoscaler retries exhausted before retrying alternative regions; no proactive headroom alert. Next steps include quota headroom alert + automated multi-region fallback for dedicated pools.

(END)
